BiblicalUsage: This is a hair-net, one of the fine ornaments worn by the daughters of Zion in their pride. Isaiah lists it among the tinkling ornaments and round tires that the Lord would take away in the day of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God notices the small vanities we dress ourselves in, and His judgment strips away what we trusted instead of Him.
